desc: Derive/verify path-compression lemma: for intersecting endpoints, an optimal path is direct if disjoint, otherwise a 2-edge path through a vertex outside the union, or a 3-edge path of one of the two strict side-pair forms.

Implement the final O(N+Q) Python solution with fast I/O, strict prefix/suffix minima, and the query formulas; public samples pass and code review confirms strict inequalities, endpoint exclusion, and INF handling.
